title: Master status shows no slow events query once older delta rows have their stage stored
description: On a running test install seeded with 50 merged items of 800-row delta chains written before delta rows stored their stage, loop cycles store the stage on at most 1,000 rows each until none lack it; master status then shows no events query over 3 seconds.

steps.name: after the backfill finishes, master status shows no events query over 3 s
